name: m3t2
description: Learning-and-rusting arc on an open grass field: one named novice Pop (Identity/Traits/Skills rows via the spawnUnit identity branch) chops a large wood node continuously, practicing gathering from zero (+500 XP of granted theory at setup as its permanent knowledge floor). Around tick ~7000 the node depletes, the Pop idles, and the rare-tick rust accumulator machine drains all practice back toward the knowledge floor over the following simulated days: one-day grace, then 100 practice XP shed every 8 idle rare-ticks. Skill-sheet samples are pinned at day boundaries; digests every 30th tick plus final; doubles as the extended double-run determinism canary.
